plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Harness audit methodology (four pillars, executable rubric, independent verifier) + the six loops that converge against it (/orchestrate, /skill-loop, /review-loop, /iterate, /session-review, plus the stateless preflight pattern) + a zero-token telemetry dashboard (loop-stats.js) + write-time security guards + a repeat-tool loop-hygiene guard.
